features.title: Search and select provider models
features.summary: Search provider-grouped model catalogs in the composer, expose supported reasoning controls, and delegate context-aware route handoff to the shared selection directory.
failureModes: A search with no catalog match shows an explicit empty state without clearing the current model or reasoning effort.
Reasoning controls stay unavailable until a model is selected.
A handoff compacts only when both route capacities are known, the target is smaller, and the current projected pressure reaches 80% of the target window.
Unknown or stale context measurements skip the handoff compaction; DSH's normal pre-request compaction remains responsible for the next request.
A failed manual compaction leaves the current model/account selected.

externalDependencies.boundary: The session projection provides provider-anchored but approximate next-request context pressure.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Pure threshold tests cover stale, unknown, equal, larger, and smaller route measurements.

externalDependencies.boundary: The shared selection directory calls the registered route-capacity API and owns /compact preflight for every model-selection surface.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The model-selection directory tests exercise threshold decisions, compaction ordering and failure handling.

externalDependencies.boundary: The existing /compact command performs an idle-session compaction and reports whether compaction failed.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The shared directory tests exercise the manual compaction contract; the real profile owns command execution.

verification.testName: returns known and unknown context capacity and rejects invalid route input

features.title: Enable Fast mode on supported Codex models
features.summary: The composer picker shows Fast mode only for explicitly supported AI Accounts Codex models. AI Accounts can enable it by default, with per-session route overrides, and adds the legacy service_tier=priority through pi-ai's supported payload hook. The composer shows a lightning icon while Fast mode is enabled.
reach: fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "Open a scratch session for Fast mode"
click text "Open a scratch session for*"
expect switch "Fast mode; may cost more"
click switch "Fast mode; may cost more"
expect switch "Fast mode; may cost more"
failureModes: Without an eligible AI Accounts Codex route/model the switch stays hidden.
Unsupported models and non-Codex provider routes never receive the Fast service tier.
Fast mode is off by default, unless AI Accounts enables the default; a thread can override each supported route.
The composer model icon changes from sparkles to a lightning bolt only while Fast mode is enabled.

verification.testName: uses the legacy priority tier when Fast mode is enabled per thread or by default

telemetry.reason: The picker calls @dshfiles/ai-accounts, whose api-dispatch spans that catalog lists; this plugin serves no Host method of its own.

features.title: Swap to the next account offering the same model
features.summary: A swap button beside the composer model picker moves the Session to the next provider route, in catalog order, that offers the selected model id, keeping the reasoning effort when the target advertises it.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the swap button. It only renders when another route offers the selected model.
Provider route ids to rotate through; empty rotates through every route that offers the selected model.

failureModes: No other route offers the selected model, or every other one is excluded by accountSwapRoutes: the button stays hidden.
A target model without the current reasoning effort falls back to its own default effort.
The button stays disabled while a selection is pending, so a second click during a slow Host select does nothing.

verification.testName: moves to the next route offering the same model, skipping routes without it
wraps around and falls back to the target default when it lacks the current effort
rotates only through the configured routes, and offers nothing when no other route qualifies

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Swap to the next account offering the same model renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Edit the model fallback chain from the composer picker
features.summary: A Fallbacks section in the composer model picker adds the current selection to the thread's or the default fallback chain, reorders and removes rungs, picks whether a thread stays on a fallback, and returns a thread to its selection. AI Accounts owns the chain on the Host and walks it under Priority distribution.
failureModes: Without the AI Accounts fallback API (older Host or no AI Accounts) the section stays hidden and the picker works as before.
Outside Priority distribution the section says the chain does not run.
A failed Host write keeps the stored chain and shows the error inline.

verification.testName: reorders and removes rungs without leaving the chain

telemetry.reason: Chain edits go through the @dshfiles/ai-accounts API, whose api-dispatch spans that catalog lists; this plugin serves no Host method of its own.
